fields.name: subject
fields.title: Subject
fields.description: What the fact is ABOUT — a repo-rooted path, a symbol, a run id. Never a bare filename: an ambiguous reference is a wrong value waiting to be read.

fields.name: quantity
fields.title: Quantity
fields.description: The observable being measured (a count, a status code, a boolean predicate).

fields.name: claim
fields.title: Claim
fields.description: The measured value, stated as a discrete predicate.

fields.name: evidence
fields.title: Evidence
fields.description: Free prose. L6 BY CONSTRUCTION — the level grammar never reads this field and no wording here can raise a level.

fields.name: rerun
fields.title: Rerun command
fields.description: ONE literal shell command that re-derives this fact. The level grammar reads this and nothing else. Required to publish.

fields.name: level
fields.title: Authority level
fields.description: Claimed authority. The level DERIVED from `rerun` is a ceiling: a claim above it is refused at publish as LEVEL-SKIP. Under-claiming is always allowed.

fields.name: observed_at
fields.title: Observed at
fields.description: When the rerun command was actually run.

fields.name: deps
fields.title: Depends on
fields.description: Subjects this fact was derived from.
